As many investors might know, we’re in the middle of a pretty dramatic rotation in the stock market. Healthcare stocks are one of those rotation stories: After lagging the market by a pretty wide margin in 2024, healthcare is the best-performing sector so far this year—that’s as of Wednesday, March 19. We have Karen Andersen, Morningstar’s director of healthcare equity research, here to help us make sense of the forces that are shaping the healthcare landscape—like those popular GLP-1 drugs—and what they mean for investors. So one of the first things I noticed this year was that when the whole market was falling a couple of weeks ago, healthcare stocks were one of the only sectors that held on. So part of it is kind of a rebound, I think, from that. And then also, I think we’re at a time where there’s a lot of uncertainty about whether there could be a recession.
